description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next.  Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.
 
 
To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Citizen. This position requires an active U.S. Government security clearance, applicants who do not currently hold the required clearance will not be eligible for consideration. Employment for cleared roles is contingent upon verification of clearance status.

 Export Control/ITAR: Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).
 
 Please review the job details below. 
 
 Vantor is seeking an   Aerospace Modeling & Simulation Software Engineer   to develop software capabilities that support advanced Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance studies for government and commercial customers. In this role, you will build and enhance simulation tools, data processing workflows, analysis applications, and visualization capabilities used to evaluate future space, airborne, and sensor systems.   
 

 This is a hands-on technical role for a software developer with an aerospace mindset—someone who enjoys designing practical tools, improving simulation capabilities, working with large technical datasets, and translating complex mission needs into reliable, maintainable software. You will contribute across fast-paced studies and longer-term efforts that help shape the systems and architectures of the future.   
 

 Note: U.S. citizenship and an active TS/SCI clearance are mandatory for this position and required for consideration.   
 

 What You’ll Do   

 Design, develop, test, and maintain software tools that support aerospace modeling, simulation, mission analysis, and data visualization.    

 Add new features and capabilities to high-fidelity   physics based   simulators used to evaluate space, airborne, and ISR sensor systems.    

 Design and implement modular, maintainable software architectures that enable new simulation features, reusable analysis workflows, and efficient integration with existing modeling and engineering tools.    

 Develop scripts, applications, APIs, and data pipelines to support scenario generation, simulation execution, post-processing, analysis, and reporting.    

 Work with aerospace engineers, analysts, and customers to translate mission needs, study objectives, and operational concepts into software requirements and technical solutions.    

 Build efficient data processing and visualization workflows for large simulation datasets.    

 Improve simulator performance, maintainability, usability, automation, and overall workflow efficiency.    

 Perform debugging, verification, validation, and QA/QC of software tools, simulation inputs, outputs, and analytical results.    

 Apply modern software engineering practices, including version control, testing, documentation, code reviews, and configuration management.    

 Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams while also owning independent software development and analysis tasks.    

 
 
 Required Qualifications   

 U.S. citizenship with an active or current TS/SCI clearance.    

 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field.  

 5 years experience. 

 Experience developing software, scripts, tools, or applications in support of engineering, modeling and simulation, data analysis, or mission analysis.    

 Experience with Python, C++, Java, C#, MATLAB, JavaScript, or similar programming languages.    

 Familiarity with aerospace systems, space systems, airborne systems, ISR missions, sensors, mission analysis, or simulation environments.    

 Willingness to work on-site.    

 

 
 Desired/Preferred Qualifications   

 Advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field.    

 8 years experience. 

 Experience developing or modifying modeling and simulation software, engineering analysis tools, mission analysis applications, or simulator frameworks.    

 Experience designing modular software architectures, reusable components, APIs, or plugin-based capabilities.    

 Working knowledge of satellites, aircraft, ISR sensors, astrodynamics, remote sensing, aerospace systems operations, or complex systems integration.    

 Experience with data processing, visualization, algorithm development, numerical methods, statistical analysis, or automated report generation.    

 Experience with Python data and scientific computing libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, Matplotlib, Plotly, or similar tools.

 Pay Transparency: In support of pay transparency at Vantor, we disclose salary ranges on all U.S. job postings.  The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the salary range provided below and is determined based on job-related factors, including, but not limited to, the experience, qualifications, knowledge, skills, geographic work location, and market conditions. Candidates with the minimum necessary experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skillsets for the position should not expect to receive the upper end of the pay range.
 
 The base pay for this position within California, Colorado, Hawaii, New Jersey, the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and for all other states is:
 
$116,000.00 - $275,000.00 
 Benefits: Vantor offers a competitive total rewards package that goes beyond the standard, including a robust 401(k) with company match, mental health resources, and unique perks like student loan repayment assistance, adoption reimbursement and pet insurance to support all aspects of your life. You can find more information on our benefits at:  https://www.Vantor.com/careers 
 
 The application window is three days from the date the job is posted and will remain posted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire.  If the job is reposted regardless of reason, it will remain posted three days from the date the job is reposted and will remain reposted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire. 
 
 The date of posting can be found on Vantor's Career page at the top of each job posting.
 
 To apply, submit your application via Vantor's Career page.
 
 
 EEO Policy: Vantor is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace. We believe in fostering an environment where all team members feel respected, valued, and encouraged to share their ideas. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
